conditional_scenario.reproduction: Annual volumes: daily million units * 0.365 = billion units. Sales less field costs, G&A, production taxes and exploration plus marketing margin = EBITDA; cash tax is 23% of positive EBITDA less DDA; FCFF is EBITDA less cash tax less all three reinvestment allowances. Base EV=(FCFF+0.5)/0.105+(0.3-0.5)/1.105. Subtract 11.388-0.950+0.040+1.223 once, divide by 1.160. Equity cash proxy subtracts 0.6*(1-0.23) interest from FCFF, capitalized at 12.5% without another debt subtraction.
